description.before: Programmable, modular design, ARM9 CPU, Linux
description.after: MINDSTORMS EV3 is a historical programmable construction platform. The official retail-set archive identifies 31313 with 601 pieces and year 2013; education and retail bundles have different component selections. Manufacturer documentation supports a separate microSD-booted MicroPython workflow and EV3 ARM9/Linux firmware development. No universal built-robot mass, size, runtime or payload is inferred from the brick or an example model.

description.before: 449 pieces, 2-port Hub, 2 motors, light matrix, color sensor, Scratch coding, 4 minifigures
description.after: SPIKE Essential is the retired classroom construction/coding set 45345. The August 17, 2021 manufacturer announcement specifies 449 bricks, four character minifigures, a hub, motors, light matrix and color sensor, designed for ages 6+. Direct sales ended June 30, 2026, with SPIKE App support planned through June 30, 2031. The selected sources do not establish complete-build mass, dimensions, runtime or a mechanical DOF count.

description.before: Retired classroom robotics set with a programmable six-port Technic Large Hub, motors and sensors; SPIKE App support is scheduled through June 30, 2031.
description.after: SPIKE Prime is the retired 528-element classroom robotics set 45678. Manufacturer documentation identifies a six-port Technic Large Hub with a 5×5 LED display, six-axis inertial sensor, USB/Bluetooth and text-based Python in the SPIKE App. Hub and battery component measurements are not a complete robot size, mass or DOF rating. Direct sales ended June 30, 2026, while software support is scheduled through June 30, 2031.

chargingTime.after: Approximately 3 h empty-to-full for the Large Hub battery at standard USB 500 mA

description.before: 949-pc 5-in-1 kit, smart hub w/ 6-axis gyro, 4 motors, color+distance sensors; discontinued end 2022
description.after: MINDSTORMS Robot Inventor 51515 is the historical 949-piece 5-in-1 construction set announced June 12, 2020 for ages 10+. It includes a six-port hub, rechargeable battery, color/distance sensing and four medium angular motors. Blast, Charlie, Tricky, Gelo and M.V.P. are alternative builds of the same kit; their movements and dimensions are not universal whole-set ratings. Current app compatibility, new-unit stock and exact price remain unverified.

The selected text evidence does not establish a complete-build mass, runtime, speed, sensor specification or current sales offer.
